_taxonomy.rule: A Journey accommodation gallery is composed only from these kinds, of the hotel it names, from the Owner's Drive folder recorded in `source`; the first frame is the hotel's exterior, architecture, pool or grounds — never an arbitrary first file of a folder.
_taxonomy.lead: the first frame shows the house (exterior · architecture · pool · grounds · lobby) whenever the Owner's photography has one; a record may declare `lead` with `leadWhy` where the identity of the place is a room (a residence)
